# Nova character study

A separate, 15.008-second visual proof at `/studio/lookdev/`. It preserves Current, Original and Studio V2. The shared room accepts an optional actor factory; its default cast and mouth strength remain unchanged.

## Implemented

- Derived Blender-authored GLB from the existing CC0 MPFB base: softer cheek/jaw contour, reshaped nose, sculpted bob, brows, integrated eyes, brass earrings and ivory clothing.
- Retained skeleton and 66 facial morph targets; corrected blink deformation. Baked ambient occlusion is exported in the GLB material.
- One shared room, one renderer and a fixed camera with portrait-specific distance. HDR environment processed through PMREM, capped pixel ratio 1.5, rendering stops while paused/hidden.
- Two existing Nova recordings, captions and existing speech cues. Authored small head/arm beats. This is scripted animation, not live emotion inference or newly generated speech.
- Existing provider-neutral mock adapter for playback, pause, resume, replay, interruption and mute. Audio-only caption fallback for unavailable WebGL.

## Credits and provenance

- MPFB / MakeHuman base assets: CC0. https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb.html and https://static.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html . Adapted from the project's existing `dist/lab/assets/nova.glb`; no external character marketplace asset added.
- Studio Small 06 by Greg Zaal / Poly Haven: CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_06 and https://polyhaven.com/license . Downloaded original 1K Radiance HDR from https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/studio_small_06_1k.hdr .
- Three.js r170 / RGBELoader: MIT. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170 and https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r170/LICENSE . Loader pinned to the existing renderer version.
- Existing Piper/LJSpeech recordings reused without adding a voice service. See existing Studio research and asset credits for their provenance.
- Blender 4.5.3 used offline for model authoring, AO baking and review renders; no Blender runtime dependency or paid service.

## Validation and limits

The GLB is approximately 9.07 MB. Automated checks cover 66 retained base face targets, finite posed/morphed vertices, seated wrist contacts, four portrait/desktop head framings, recorded duration, caption text, audio paths and baked AO. Existing Studio rig and transport tests continue to pass.

Neutral, speaking and blinking geometry were viewed in actual offline Blender renders. These are not browser screenshots: browser material appearance, touch behavior and device frame rate remain unverified because the supported browser QA capability is unavailable. No FPS claim is made.

This is one character and one fixed angle, not a completed three-character upgrade. Hair and facial styling remain a procedural derivative of the original base, not a commissioned bespoke character. The direction is now integrated into the full Studio as three derived variants; bespoke full-cast art, close-up polish and real-device approval remain later work. Build source: `tools/build-nova-lookdev.py` (Blender required).


## Full-room integration

Studio Edition 03 uses this asset in the full conversation with independent ECHO, Nova and Atlas variants and shared HDR lighting. Open `/studio/` for the new cast or `/studio/?edition=2` for the previous cast. The 15-second study on this page remains unchanged.
